scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev --workspace @motorline/api" "npm run dev --workspace @motorline/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev --workspace @motorline/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev --workspace @motorline/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace @motorline/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace @motorline/web
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace @motorline/api && npm run build --workspace @motorline/web
scripts.test:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspace @motorline/api
scripts.test:web: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspace @motorline/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:contracts && tsx apps/web/e2e/prepare-db.ts && playwright test --config apps/web/e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.coverage: npm run build:contracts && npm run coverage --workspace @motorline/contracts && npm run coverage --workspace @motorline/api && npm run coverage --workspace @motorline/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @motorline/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @motorline/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @motorline/web
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run build && npm audit --audit-level=high && npm run security:secrets && npm run security:history
